mapper.select: SELECT wa.id, j.title as jobTitle, wa.work_date as workDate, wa.time_slot as timeSlot, j.address, CASE WHEN u.identity = 'student' THEN m.name ELSE s.name END as otherPartyName, CASE WHEN u.identity = 'student' THEN m.id ELSE s.id END as otherPartyId, j.id as jobId FROM work_assignment wa LEFT JOIN job j ON wa.job_id = j.id LEFT JOIN user u ON wa.student_id = u.id LEFT JOIN user m ON j.userId = m.id LEFT JOIN user s ON wa.student_id = s.id WHERE wa.status = 'completed' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM evaluation e WHERE e.work_assignment_id = wa.id ) AND (wa.student_id = #{userId} OR j.userId = #{userId})

SELECT e.id, j.title as jobTitle, wa.work_date as workDate, CASE WHEN e.evaluator_id = #{userId} THEN u.name ELSE m.name END as otherPartyName, e.rating, e.comment, e.created_at as createdAt FROM evaluation e LEFT JOIN work_assignment wa ON e.work_assignment_id = wa.id LEFT JOIN job j ON e.job_id = j.id LEFT JOIN user u ON e.evaluated_id = u.id LEFT JOIN user m ON e.evaluator_id = m.id WHERE e.evaluator_id = #{userId} OR e.evaluated_id = #{userId} ORDER BY e.created_at DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO evaluation (evaluator_id, evaluated_id, job_id, work_assignment_id, rating, is_positive, comment, type, created_at) VALUES (#{evaluatorId}, #{evaluatedId}, #{jobId}, #{workAssignmentId}, #{rating}, #{isPositive}, #{comment}, #{type}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT e.id, e.evaluator_id, e.evaluated_id, e.job_id, e.rating, e.comment, e.reply, e.reply_time, e.is_positive, e.created_at, u.name as evaluatorName, u.image as evaluatorImage, m.name as evaluatedName FROM evaluation e LEFT JOIN user u ON e.evaluator_id = u.id LEFT JOIN user m ON e.evaluated_id = m.id WHERE e.job_id = #{jobId} AND e.type = 'student_to_merchant' ORDER BY e.created_at DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE evaluation SET is_positive = #{isPositive} WHERE id = #{evaluationId}
mapper.select: SELECT wa.id, j.title as jobTitle, wa.work_date as workDate, wa.time_slot as timeSlot, u.name as studentName, u.id as studentId, j.id as jobId FROM work_assignment wa JOIN job j ON wa.job_id = j.id JOIN user u ON wa.student_id = u.id WHERE j.userId = #{merchantId} AND wa.status = 'completed' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM evaluation e WHERE e.work_assignment_id = wa.id AND e.type = 'merchant_to_student' )

SELECT e.id, e.rating, e.comment, e.created_at, u.name as merchantName, j.title as jobTitle FROM evaluation e JOIN user u ON e.evaluator_id = u.id LEFT JOIN work_assignment wa ON e.work_assignment_id = wa.id LEFT JOIN job j ON wa.job_id = j.id WHERE e.evaluated_id = #{studentId} AND e.type = 'merchant_to_student' ORDER BY e.created_at DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO evaluation (evaluator_id, evaluated_id, job_id, work_assignment_id, type, rating, created_at) VALUES (#{evaluatorId}, #{evaluatedId}, #{jobId}, #{workAssignmentId}, #{type}, 0, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM evaluation WHERE work_assignment_id = #{workAssignmentId} AND type = 'merchant_to_student' LIMIT 1
